hypotheses.subject: U.S. sectoral productivity dispersion and AI infrastructure demand
hypotheses.perspective: Grid-equipment manufacturers, utilities, data-centre developers and industrial operators; not an investment recommendation.
hypotheses.condition: BLS reports 2025 TFP growth in 7 of 19 major U.S. industries. Fed Governor Cook cites over US$2tn in announced U.S. data-centre projects, only a fraction realized, and roughly half of global capacity under construction estimated outside the U.S.
hypotheses.mechanism: A large announced buildout can raise demand for transformers, cables, switchgear, cooling and electricity before operating facilities and enterprise adoption produce measurable efficiency gains. The gap between announcements, financing, construction, grid connection, utilization and productivity may reveal bottlenecks.
hypotheses.trigger: Verified financial closes, procurement and delivery backlogs, interconnection queues, commissioned MW, utilization, electricity prices and later BLS TFP breadth.
hypotheses.invalidation: No sustained orders or grid constraints, repeated project cancellations, falling equipment backlogs, or no measurable utilization/productivity improvement after commissioning.
hypotheses.reason_not_promoted: This is a productivity and capital-cycle observation, not a documented structural inefficiency or leverageable capability for a defined actor. No project-level finance, contract, operating capacity or local constraint is established.

hypotheses.subject: Brazilian transmission concessions and renewable evacuation
hypotheses.perspective: Transmission developers, grid-equipment suppliers and renewable generators
hypotheses.condition: ANEEL's 30 October auction remains fully awarded; R$8.8bn, 1,866 km and 12,694 MVA are the previously staged procurement scope.
hypotheses.mechanism: Awards may expand transfer capacity only after contracts, financing, licensing, construction and commissioning.
hypotheses.trigger: Signed contracts, financing, procurement, construction, commissioning and measured transfer capacity/curtailment/reliability.
hypotheses.invalidation: Cancelled or delayed contracts, no finance or commissioning, or no measured improvement.

hypotheses.subject: Uzbekistan electricity-distribution modernization
hypotheses.perspective: Grid users, renewable developers and equipment suppliers
hypotheses.condition: World Bank/ADB financing and 60-substation programme already staged; no new execution milestone.
hypotheses.mechanism: Modernization could reduce losses and enable renewables only after disbursement, procurement and commissioning.
hypotheses.trigger: Verified disbursements, contract awards, commissioned substations and measured losses.
hypotheses.invalidation: No implementation progress or operating improvement.

hypotheses.subject: Korean electrical-equipment exports for grid and AI infrastructure
hypotheses.perspective: Manufacturers and buyers of transformers, cables and grid equipment
hypotheses.condition: Existing 1 November signal records a nominal October export record; no new volume or customer-level commissioning data.
hypotheses.mechanism: Export receipts indicate demand but do not establish physical capacity or margins.
hypotheses.trigger: Customs volumes, backlogs, delivery destinations and commissioned projects.
hypotheses.invalidation: Nominal values reverse or no delivery is linked to a project.

hypotheses.subject: Asia DRIVE energy-resilience credit fund
hypotheses.perspective: Private infrastructure developers seeking long-tenor financing
hypotheses.condition: Existing announced US$750m target fund and up-to US$50m IFC participation; no new close or disbursement.
hypotheses.mechanism: Risk-sharing capital may lower financing hurdles only if capital is raised and projects funded.
hypotheses.trigger: Paid-in capital, financial close, named projects and disbursement.

hypotheses.subject: Hartha power-station outage in Iraq
hypotheses.condition: Fire reportedly halted operations at a plant operating around 400 MW before the event; cause and restoration unknown.
hypotheses.mechanism: Local outage may affect reliability, but no durable capacity gap or investment path is established.
hypotheses.trigger: Official cause, damage assessment, restoration date and verified grid data.
hypotheses.invalidation: Rapid restoration with no durable network constraint.

hypotheses.subject: Gulf maritime-security incident near Khasab
hypotheses.perspective: Shipping operators, insurers and energy cargo counterparties
hypotheses.condition: UKMTO incident relayed by Reuters; vessel identity and actor attribution unknown.
hypotheses.mechanism: A verified pattern could affect insurance and routing, but one unresolved report does not establish a durable opportunity.
hypotheses.trigger: Direct UKMTO notice, vessel identity, verified damage, insurance quotes and route-level freight data.
hypotheses.invalidation: No confirmed linkage or measurable shipping/insurance change.

reason_no_canonical_change: The new productivity signal remains a research hypothesis, not a documented structural state for a defined actor. Existing Brazil, Uzbekistan, Korea and Asia DRIVE candidates have no new financing, procurement, commissioning or operating-output evidence. No canonical snapshot or history event was changed; review/reclassification remains task 2/5.
